title: Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham TPB (Trade Paperback, DC Comics, 2023)
descriptionText:
Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham TPB (Trade Paperback, DC Comics, 2023) – Mike Mignola, Troy Nixey – NOW A DC ANIMATED MOVIE
Condition: Like New / Excellent
🦇 Description:
From Mike Mignola, the acclaimed creator of Hellboy, comes a chilling Elseworlds tale blending the world of Gotham City with Lovecraftian cosmic horror. Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham reimagines the Dark Knight as a 1920s adventurer who returns to Gotham after twenty years abroad—only to unleash an ancient terror upon the city.
A terrifying union of pulp adventure, supernatural horror, and gothic atmosphere, this story stands as one of the most unique Batman tales ever told. Now adapted into a DC Animated Original Movie!
📖 Collects:
Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham #1–3
👁️ Story Summary (from back cover):
Set in Gotham City, 1928, Bruce Wayne returns after two decades to find the city under siege from horrors beyond imagination. As “The Lurker on the Threshold” and his cult rise, Batman must confront monstrous beings, immortal sorcerers, and the madness of the unknown — and discover how terrible Bruce Wayne can truly become.
🖋️ Credits:
Writers: Mike Mignola & Richard Pace
Artist: Troy Nixey
Inker: Dennis Janke
Colorist: Dave Stewart
Letterer: Bill Oakley
Cover Artist: Mike Mignola
📚 Details:
Publisher: DC Comics
Release Year: 2023 (reprint edition)
ISBN: 978-1-77952-149-1
Cover Price: $16.99 USD
Format: Softcover / Trade Paperback
Genre: Superhero, Horror, Elseworlds
📸 Condition Notes:
Book is in excellent, like-new condition.
Cover shows minimal to no wear.
Spine tight, corners sharp, pages bright and clean.
See photos for actual item condition.
